# PTxray

> PTxray is an open-source IBM AIX and IBM i assessment. Assessment probes change no system configuration, perform no remediation, make no network calls, and send no assessment data or telemetry away from the host. A separate downloader acquires verified inputs before assessment. Unavailable evidence remains NOT_ASSESSED.

Canonical page: https://powertruesystems.com/ptxray/
Source repository: https://github.com/PowerTrueSYS/ptxray-public
Published version: 1.8.1
Release: https://github.com/PowerTrueSYS/ptxray-public/releases/tag/v1.8.1
License: Apache-2.0

## Acquisition and execution

Download and verify the complete signed release. Extract ptxray-report-aix-1.8.1.tar or ptxray-report-ibmi-1.8.1.tar. The bundled runners are the product entry points; top-level runner copies need the full extracted tool tree.

AIX: create report/, then run ksh dist/tools/aixray-scan.ksh --html --pdf --json --compliance all --out report. Requires root, native ksh93, supported OpenSSL, and curl/unzip for connected acquisition. IBM FLRTVC runs offline on fresh fileset/interim-fix inventory after separate acquisition. The complete IBM report and exposure rows are preserved.

IBM i: create report/, then run ksh dist/tools/ibmi-scan.ksh --html --json --compliance all --out report. Requires PASE ksh and QSECOFR as session and effective user. Consult the bundle README for SQL-service and tool prerequisites. IBM i uses its native evidence and PTF data, not AIX FLRTVC.

Assessment outputs remain local: report.html, report.json and scan.ptx, plus platform-specific outputs. Requested reports and protected scratch/cache files are local writes. --offline uses verified cached inputs; local definitions must include their detached signature. Offline AIX also needs the pinned engine staged in the verified cache. Connected acquisition is disclosed before assessment and sends no assessment data.

## Inspectable facts and limits

- The public catalog records 585 standalone check tools and exact artifact hashes. This number is not a finding count or a benchmark coverage fraction.
- Read-only checks cover platform-specific security and operational health, with explicit CIS L1 and L2 selections and an all-catalog selection.
- A completed scan does not prove security, full compliance, recoverability, or absence of defects. Standards labels are alignment, not certification.
- Missing, unreadable, invalid or unsupported evidence remains NOT_ASSESSED; do not summarize it as PASS.
- The report discloses coverage and data age. Do not infer that every benchmark recommendation is automated.
- VIOS assessment remains disabled pending live acceptance.
- Downloads require no email, form, registration, or payment. Optional contact and signup links are separate.
- The review-copy helper rejects current composed reports because their privacy annotations do not meet its strict contract. Manually review and remove sensitive information before sharing any full report.

## Primary documents

README.md explains complete bundle usage. docs/VERIFY.md gives signature-first release verification. SECURITY.md defines the trust boundary and private reporting channel. catalog.json and checks/ expose the standalone code and command manifests. docs/auditing-aix.md is the audit guide.
